setting: Development only, shared connected80 scenario with 0.2 m/s warning in dynamic cases
heldout_acceptance: No formal acceptance attempts or claims
model_selection: One capped joint update batch, keep last KL-accepted epoch with changed weights. Prefer all four H300 training domains. If a full rollout is unavailable, report exact omissions. Separate D1 branch reserved for engineering diagnostics.
pair_priority: R1/P1 first, followed by R0 and P0 as CPU time permits. Never exchange training and development seeds.
termination: Keep all 3000 physical ticks. An unsafe or unsuccessful complete H300 gets C=300. Truncation has no C.
